items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: George Lewis was alright. But I didn't know George in, let's see.

ctx.x: Georgey Boy. Oh, Georgey Boy. There's so many George's. How about George Lewis in those days? Do you remember him?

Well George, George was alright. George Lewis was alright. But I didn't know George in, let's see. I was up in there in that time doing Jimbo. Doing Jimbo and Zep and them. I don't remember George at all.
Well he's eight years younger than George. He wouldn't be around now. I guess by the time he got to going, Jimbo had left town.
He was George. George Lewis. Uh-huh. I see. After that, you get mad, you go by.
I see. Well, how about Cotterall? I wonder how Kelly sounded with Cotterall. Was Kelly a reader? No.
